title: Coco Chanel's birth chart
metaDescription: Coco Chanel's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.1° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 26.1° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 26.1° Leo, inside the third decan (20°–30°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 14.6° Virgo; Venus stands at 17.3° Leo; Mars stands at 27.0° Gemini. The tradition reads thought with its feet on the ground from Mercury, attraction declared rather than implied from Venus, effort aimed through strategy and words from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Mars hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 0.9° wide. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Uranus trine Neptune at 0.9°, and Jupiter sextile Uranus at 1.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. The Sun in Leo at 26.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Virgo at 14.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Cancer at 23.0° is in exaltation. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 3 earth, 3 air, 2 fire, 2 water; by modality, 6 mutable, 3 fixed, 1 cardinal. Earth counts what remains: the built, the kept, the finished. Promise weighs less than delivery. Not one planet was retrograde, so the whole chart reads in direct motion.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 9.0°.
